old_en: You hear a squelch, and the tentacle unravels. It points at the water, as if watching something. A shape lunges from the water. The tentacle unravels the rest of the way, dropping you and recoiling in fright.
old_kr: 질척이는 소리가 들리고 촉수가 풀린다. 그것은 무언가를 보는 것처럼 물을 가리킨다. 형체 하나가 물속에서 튀어 오른다. 촉수는 완전히 풀리며 당신을 떨어뜨리고, 겁먹은 듯 움츠러든다.
new_en: You hear a squelch, and the tentacle unravels. It points at the water, as if watching something. A shape lunges from the water. The tentacle unravels the rest of the way, dropping you and recoiling in fright.

old_en: You hear a squelch, and a shape lunges from the water, landing on your thigh. A slug, as large as a cat. Another joins it, wrapping around the rope. It gnaws through with disturbing speed, and you splash into the water.
old_kr: 질척이는 소리가 들리고, 형체 하나가 물속에서 튀어 올라 허벅지에 달라붙는다. 고양이만 한 민달팽이다. 또 하나가 합류해 밧줄을 감싼다. 그것은 불쾌할 만큼 빠르게 밧줄을 갉아 끊고, 당신은 물속으로 떨어진다.
new_en: You hear a squelch, and a shape lunges from the water, landing on your thigh. A slug, as large as a cat. Another joins it, wrapping around the rope. It gnaws through with disturbing speed, and you splash into the water.

old_en: A slug leaps out as you pass, narrowly missing you.<>
old_kr: 지나가는 순간 민달팽이가 튀어나와, 아슬아슬하게 빗나간다.<>
new_en: A slug leaps out as you pass, narrowly missing you.<>

old_en: A shape lunges from the water. It misses, landing on the cave wall behind you. A large slug. Another swims towards you.
old_kr: 형체 하나가 물속에서 튀어 오른다. 그것은 빗나가 뒤쪽 동굴 벽에 달라붙는다. 커다란 민달팽이다. 또 하나가 당신을 향해 헤엄쳐 온다.
new_en: A shape lunges from the water. It misses, landing on the cave wall behind you. A large slug. Another swims towards you.
